required_actions: Open Messages, tap Compose (critical)

Contact the carrier (critical)

unsupported_claims: 'Once your plan supports it, MMS Messaging can be turned on in Settings, then Messages.' -> page does not say the option appears after the plan supports it
reasons: Last line 'Once your plan supports it, MMS Messaging can be turned on in Settings, then Messages' is an inference; the page only says to contact the provider to confirm whether group MMS is included. It also does not acknowledge the cousin who did not get the message.
fix: Delete the sentence 'Once your plan supports it, **MMS Messaging** can be turned on in **Settings**, then **Messages**.' Keep the two carrier steps, matching the page: 'If you don't see an option to turn on MMS Messaging, contact your mobile provider to confirm whether group MMS is included in your plan.'

reasons: G2 caution: step 2 'If you do want this paid app, tap the price' nudges a low-confidence user toward starting a purchase with no warning that it costs money.
fix: Keep step 1. Replace step 2 with: 'Tapping the price is how you buy the app, so only tap it if you mean to pay for it.' (The page says to tap Install for no-charge apps or the app's price for paid apps.) Do not suggest buying.
